text:
Elaine: Mariner Health POC — need model catalog fit for their med-qa workflow. They asked for a 13B clinically tuned model with 8-bit quant, low-latency SLA, and HIPAA data handling. Who can validate variant compatibility and pricing? cc @Sam @Jordan
Sam: I can check. Quick note: our mariner-gpt-13b-ft has a KV profile that doesn't play well with 8-bit on A100-80GB without kernel fallback. Ops can run `redwood check-model mariner-gpt-13b-ft --quant=8` for a quick sim. :eyes:
Jordan: I'll own POC ops. Need to confirm tokenizer alignment and prompt windows. Elaine, do they have long-context (>8k) docs or mostly short notes?
Elaine: They have both. mostly <4k but ~20% of records are ~12k discharge summaries.
Sam: 12k means we should use the 16k-context variant (mariner-13k). Quant->8 may still work but expect ~10-20% latency increase and some autobatch fallbacks for long seqs. Suggest we offer two variants in the POC: mariner-13k-8q (cost saver) and mariner-13k-fp16 (latency).
Devon: Security here — we need completed vendor security questionnaire, confirmation of PHI handling, and a signed BAA before private deployment. I'll need the customer's infosec contact. Docs: https://redwood.internal/security/hipaa-checklist :lock:
Elaine: They also asked about price delta hosted vs dedicated for a short POC (2-week, ~10 req/s average, bursts to 50). Any rough guidance?
Sam: Rough ballpark: hosted gen for 13B quant ~ $0.012–$0.02 per 1k tokens depending on burst and cache hit rate. Dedicated monthly baseline is cheaper for sustained but heavy for a 2-week POC. Recommend hosted + a short dedicated trial (burst). I'll run a quick calc with their token estimates. :+1:
Jordan: Quick infra scan next so we know compatibility constraints.
deploy-bot: ran `redwood model-scan mariner-13k-8q --env=staging` -> warnings: ["kv-cache mismatch on cuda kernel", "autobatch fallback for seq>4096"]. Full log: https://redwood.logs/scan/1768888888
Elaine: Okay actionable items: @Devon will send HIPAA checklist & BAA request, @Sam will post perf/pricing estimate by EOD, @Jordan will schedule POC kickoff with Mariner and confirm long-context handling. I'll prep the commercial note for the customer. :calendar:
Devon: Sending security docs now. If they require on-prem, SRE will need a network whitelist (10.20.0.0/16) and a short support addendum.
Sam: Quick perf estimate for planning: mariner-13k-fp16 ≈ 120ms per token at 10 req/s on 1xA100-80GB; mariner-13k-8q ≈ 160ms per token but ~30% cheaper in compute. Detailed cost table coming in thread.
Elaine: Great — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize POC scope. Thanks team :rocket:
